meta.name: Warehouse
meta.description: Orders are picked by three pickers; one order in five goes through a 5 min inspection; every order is packed at one station. Written fresh at M1 to the spec 2 targets: throughput within 1% of 60 per hour, pack utilization 0.75 to 0.85. Orders arrive 60 per hour (exponential, mean 1 min) and no block loses items, so throughput is 60 per hour. Utilization = arrival rate x mean service time / capacity: pick 60 per hour x 2 min / 3 = 0.667; pack 60 per hour x 0.8 min = 0.80. By Burke's theorem each station sees Poisson arrivals: pick is M/M/3 with probability of waiting 4/9 (Erlang C) and mean wait 0.889 min; pack is M/M/1 with mean wait rho / (1 - rho) x 0.8 min = 3.2 min. Mean cycle time (time in each station, wait plus service, and the inspection for one order in five) pick 2.889 + inspection 0.2 x 5 + pack 4.0 = 7.889 min.
